description: This file defines React components and hooks for menu items with text truncation and tooltips in a Superset frontend project, including MenuItemWithTruncation, VirtualizedMenuItem, and related utilities.

methods.name: TruncatedMenuLabel
methods.description: A React component that displays a tooltip with truncated text if the content overflows.

methods.name: useMenuItemWithTruncation
methods.description: A hook that returns a function to create menu items with truncation and tooltip support.

methods.name: MenuItemWithTruncation
methods.description: A React component representing a menu item with text truncation and tooltip.

methods.name: VirtualizedMenuItem
methods.description: A React component for a menu item with virtualization support, text truncation, and theme-based styling.
